think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any in-range numeric value is designated as a sentinel (e.g., -1, 0) that switches the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than simply adjusting magnitude. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record those values; otherwise classify as not special.
